meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: Claude 会用真实手机号通过 dial 命令行发短信、拨打由 AI 语音代理接管的电话、等待并收取对方发来的短信或验证码,还能购买和设置号码。每条命令都支持 --json 输出。
howto.when: 当你提到电话、短信、语音、OTP、2FA、验证码等关键词,或要求给某人发短信、打电话、等验证码,或本会话首次运行 dial 命令时触发。

say.text: 用 dial 给 +14155550123 发条短信,内容是「你好」
say.note: 执行 dial message 发送并返回结果

say.text: 给这个号码打个 AI 语音电话,确认明天的预约
等一条短信验证码,收到后把验证码告诉我

howto.what_en: Claude gets a dial command-line tool that uses a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, wait for inbound texts and verification codes, and manage numbers. Every command supports --json output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention phones, calls, texts, SMS, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; ask to text or call someone; wait for a code; or before the first dial command in a session.

say_en.note: Runs dial message and returns the result

say_en.text: Call this number with an AI voice agent to confirm tomorrow's appointment
say_en.note: Starts dial call; check it later with dial call get

say_en.text: Wait for an SMS verification code and tell me the code
